warning: Derived after the underlying cases were exposed. This file adds no scientific cases, is REGRESSION_ONLY, and must not be treated as fresh validation or historical experimental design.

definition.metamorphic_relation: A controlled known-case regression relation in which the scenario is held sufficiently fixed, one named legally material state variable changes, and the consequential expected outcome/relation is already supported on both sides by existing evidence.
exclusions: Same trap class alone is not a metamorphic relation.
Analogous cases with different instruments, actors, facts or procedures are not treated as controlled pairs.
No counterfactual expected answer may be invented from a trap-class label.
A relation requiring new legal research is excluded.

relations.controlled_scenario: Two otherwise valid licence applications received by the same issuing authority on the same working Tuesday; Wednesday is also a working day.
invariant_state: same governing rule: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2016/1239 Article 3(1)
same calendar day and validity assumptions

expected_relation.consequence: A two-minute crossing of the 13:00 boundary changes the legally deemed lodgement day.

relations.controlled_scenario: Stripchat remains in the same designation state across the adjacent dates around the preserved Section 5 application start.
invariant_state: designation remains in force across the selected adjacent dates

expected_relation.before: designated, but Section 5 additional obligations not yet applicable
expected_relation.after: designated, and Section 5 additional obligations applicable
expected_relation.consequence: Designation state can remain unchanged while application state flips at its own legal boundary.

relations.controlled_scenario: The Toy Safety Directive Article 13 gateway and EN 71-1:2014+A1:2018 standard identity remain unchanged.
invariant_state: target product scope remains the specified wave-roller clauses

expected_relation.before: published reference has no wave-roller-specific restriction
expected_relation.after: specified wave-roller clauses no longer confer the same presumption of conformity for the restricted scope
expected_relation.consequence: An external authoritative status mutation narrows legal effect without parent-gateway or standard-identifier mutation.

relations.controlled_scenario: Same Member State (Ireland) and same Regulation (EU) 2024/1351; compare the preserved adoption-state participation position with the later confirmed post-adoption opt-in state.
invariant_state: same participation regime family: Protocol 21 Article 4 route

mutation.from: not participating / not bound at adoption under the preserved Protocol 21 state
mutation.to: participation confirmed after Ireland's notification and Commission Decision (EU) 2024/2088

expected_relation.before: the adoption-state recital cannot be read as Ireland participating in the Regulation
expected_relation.after: Ireland participates following the legally operative post-adoption route
expected_relation.consequence: Participation in the same EU act is time-varying and cannot be inferred from either the adoption recital or today's participant state alone.

relations.limitation: This relation concerns participation/binding state. It does not assert that every substantive provision of the Regulation was already applicable on 22 August 2024.
